fact: The first planet found orbiting a Sun-like star — the world that opened the exoplanet era.
bio: 51 Pegasi b, informally named Dimidium, was discovered in 1995 by Michel Mayor and Didier Queloz — the first confirmed planet around a normal Sun-like star, a find that earned them the 2019 Nobel Prize in Physics. A 'hot Jupiter' skimming its star every four days, it stunned astronomers who never expected a giant planet so close in, and forced a rethink of how planetary systems form and migrate.
